drug_indication: First-Line Squamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
catalyst_text: Presented positive overall survival results at ASCO
detailed_catalyst_text: Phase III HARMONi-6 in first-line squamous NSCLC showed a statistically significant overall survival improvement versus tislelizumab plus chemotherapy (HR 0.66; p=0.0017). The data were presented in an ASCO 2026 plenary session and simultaneously published in The Lancet. These results indicate a clinically meaningful benefit over a PD-1 inhibitor plus chemotherapy in this setting.
catalyst_text_evidence: "Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ:SMMT) today announced positive overall survival (OS) results from the Phase III HARMONi-6 trial... will be presented today as part of the Plenary Session at the 2026 American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) Annual Meeting in Chicago." "In the HARMONi-6 planned interim analysis of OS, ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy demonstrated a statistically significant improvement when compared to tislelizumab in combination with chemotherapy, with a hazard ratio (HR) of 0.66 (95% CI: 0.50, 0.87; p=0.0017)." "The Lancet simultaneously published these findings in a manuscript titled, 'Ivonescimab plus Chemotherapy for Squamous Non-small-cell Lung Cancer.'"

catalyst_text: Presented encouraging Phase 2 data in colorectal cancer
detailed_catalyst_text: New interim Phase II results of the AK112-206 study in first-line metastatic colorectal cancer were presented at a major oncology meeting. Evaluable patients treated with the combination showed a 70.8% ORR and 100% DCR with a manageable safety profile, supporting further clinical development.
catalyst_text_evidence: Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ:SMMT) today presented new results from the AK112-206 trial (NCT05382442), a global, open-label, multicenter Phase II study in first-line metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) co-sponsored by Summit and Akeso, featuring the novel, potential first-in-class investigational bispecific antibody ivonescimab. The data were presented today at the 2026 American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) Annual Meeting in Chicago. In this U.S.- and China-based Phase II cohort of treatment-naïve patients with mCRC, patients receiving ivonescimab in combination with standard-of-care doublet chemotherapy mFOLFOX6 demonstrated an objective response rate (ORR) of 70.8% across both arms in evaluable patients (n=48). Overall Study Population Achieved ORR of 70.8% and DCR of 100.0%; Responses Consistent Across Ivonescimab Dose Levels Combined with Chemotherapy.

catalyst_text: BLA accepted PDUFA set for November 14 2026
detailed_catalyst_text: The FDA accepted the Biologics License Application for ivonescimab based on the HARMONi Phase III study in EGFR-mutated non-squamous NSCLC after third-generation EGFR TKI therapy. A target PDUFA decision date has been set for 2026-11-14, marking a key regulatory milestone.
catalyst_text_evidence: HARMONi is a Phase III clinical trial evaluating ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a third- generation EGFR TKI (e.g., osimertinib). Detailed results of the study were provided in September 2025, and a Biologics License Application (BLA) was submitted to the United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for marketing authorization, which the FDA accepted for filing in January 2026; the goal Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) date is November 14, 2026.

catalyst_text: BLA accepted with PDUFA set for November 2026
detailed_catalyst_text: The FDA accepted for filing a biologics license application for ivonescimab plus chemotherapy in EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC after prior third-generation EGFR TKI therapy. The agency also assigned a PDUFA goal action date of November 14, 2026. This advances the program into formal US regulatory review for this post-TKI population.
catalyst_text_evidence: Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ:SMMT) ("Summit," "we," or the "Company") today announced that the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA) has accepted for filing Summit's Biologics License Application (BLA) seeking approval for ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy in patients with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)-mutated locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) post-tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) therapy. The FDA provided a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) goal action date of 2026-11-14.

catalyst_text: Submitted BLA to FDA for this indication
detailed_catalyst_text: A Biologics License Application was submitted to the FDA for use of the bispecific antibody with chemotherapy in second-line or later EGFR-mutated locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC after progression on a third-generation EGFR TKI. The filing is supported by results from the global Phase 3 HARMONi trial and represents a key regulatory milestone toward potential approval in this setting.
catalyst_text_evidence: "Summit Therapeutics Inc. (NASDAQ:SMMT) ... today announced that it has submitted a Biologics License Application (BLA) to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) seeking approval for ivonescimab, the novel, first-in-class investigational bispecific antibody, in combination with chemotherapy in second-line or later treatment of patients with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)-mutated locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)." "The BLA submission was based on the overall results of the global Phase III HARMONi trial." "The BLA was submitted during the fourth quarter of 2025."
